title: Giraffe: A Mapping Architecture from Hidden Text Representations to Visual Embeddings for Efficient Graphic Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.23970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in understanding and interpreting mul- timedia content. However, their ability to generate me- dia remains limited. Recent approaches have attempted to bridge this gap by translating the hidden representations of token sequences into the embedding space of visual models or directly into raw image data. However, these methods often represent each image using multiple specialised to- kens which significantly increases the input length. This be- comes a major limitation for tasks such as graphic design generation where the output typically involves a seamless blend of thousands of tokens across text, multiple images, and layout information. translated_title: 长颈鹿：一种从隐藏文本表示到视觉嵌入的映射架构，用于高效图形设计
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在理解和解释多媒体内容方面取得了显著进展。然而，它们生成媒体的能力仍然有限。最近的方法试图通过将token序列的隐藏表示转换为视觉模型的嵌入空间或直接转换为原始图像数据来弥合这一差距。然而，这些方法通常使用多个专门的token来表示每个图像，这显著增加了输入长度。这成为图形设计生成等任务的主要限制，因为此类输出通常涉及文本、多张图像和布局信息中数千个token的无缝混合。为了应对这一挑战，提出了一种新颖的架构，该架构使用每个图像单个[IMG]token，将隐藏token表示映射到视觉模型（如CLIP ViT-L/14）的嵌入空间。该架构采用两个s（此处原文截断，但根据上下文推测为“两个阶段”或“两个组件”）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“长颈鹿”的新架构，通过每个图像仅用一个[IMG]token将隐藏文本表示映射到视觉嵌入空间，大幅缩短输入长度，从而高效支持图形设计生成任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel architecture named "Giraffe" that maps hidden text representations to visual embedding space using a single [IMG] token per image, significantly reducing input length to efficiently support graphic design generation tasks.
